profile.headline: SSE-2 @ New Engen | MSC @ NCSU | Full-Stack Developer, Distributed Systems | React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python, Java, Spring Boot | Cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) | Data Visualization
profile.summary:
👋 Software Engineer passionate about building scalable software applications and data-driven solutions

I'm Jay Patel, a Software Engineer at New Engen with a Master's in Computer Science from NCSU (4.0/4.0 GPA). I specialize in full-stack development with expertise in React, TypeScript, Node.js, Java, spring boot and cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure).

💻 Technical Expertise:
- Front-end: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Redux, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind CSS
- Back-end: Node.js, Express, Python, PHP, RESTful APIs, Java, Spring Boot, GraphQL
- Databases: MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Firestore
- Cloud & DevOps: AWS S3, CloudFront, GitHub Actions, Docker, Redis
- Tools: Git, CI/CD pipelines, Figma, VS Code
- Testing: Jest, Playwright

🚀 Key Achievements:
- Engineered high-performance data visualization features processing 10M+ records in <1.5 seconds using Redis caching and DB optimization, saving $3,000 monthly in external service costs
- Drove 30% increase in user acquisition by implementing a responsive React single-page application with optimized UI/UX flows and RESTful API integration
- Reduced image loading time by 50% through AWS S3 migration and CloudFront CDN implementation, significantly improving website performance metrics and user experience
- Automated critical backend processes using Python Cron jobs and Google Cloud APIs, reducing manual workload by 30% and eliminating human error
- Architected and deployed a MERN stack E-commerce platform that increased online revenue by 30% through seamless user experience and optimized purchase flows
- Developed an NLP-powered document analysis application (PDFGPT) using LangChain and OpenAI, enabling contextual question-answering for complex technical documents

👥 Community Leadership:
- Microsoft Learn Student Ambassador mentoring new developers
- Former General Secretary of Google Developer Student Clubs (GDSC-PDEU)
- Web Development Head at Encode, leading a team of 5 developers

I'm driven by building efficient, user-focused solutions that solve real business problems through clean code and innovative approaches. Currently seeking Software Engineering opportunities where I can leverage my full-stack expertise to create impactful applications.

Let's connect to discuss software engineering or potential opportunities!

📧 jaypatel32157@gmail.com
🔗 Portfolio: https://pateljay.me/

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implemented a React single-page application within a Rails framework that enhanced the influencer onboarding process, resulting in a 30% increase in new user signups and improved user experience through a streamlined, responsive interface.
- Engineered a motion sequence feature with graph visualization that processes 3M+ data in 1-1.5 seconds using Redis caching, GraphQL and SQL query optimization, delivering dynamic brand-specific reports with custom filters and metrics, saving $3,000 monthly spent on motion services.
- Architected database optimization strategies for massive datasets (10M+ rows) implementing partitioning by brand and time-based subpartitioning, alongside materialized views with incremental refresh mechanisms, reducing query execution time by 85% and improving API response times from 8s to under 1s for data-intensive creative reporting dashboards
- Spearheaded comprehensive test automation strategy by implementing Jest for backend unit/integration testing and React Testing Library with Cypress for frontend E2E testing, increasing code coverage from 45% to 80%, reducing production bugs by 65%, and establishing robust CI/CD testing protocols that prevented 12 critical issues from reaching production

positions.locationName: Raleigh, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Implemented a Cron job system utilizing Python for real-time temperature monitoring across campus servers, enabling data-driven decisions for optimal server management.
- Automated the order management system through Smartsheet, reducing email overhead and increasing the order processing efficiency by 25%.
- Integrated touchless reader technology, utilizing RFID, NFC, and JavaScript, reducing the time for attendance tracking by 40%
- Automated Google group member removal process using Python Cron job and Google Cloud API, reducing manual workload by 30%
- Optimized website performance by migrating image management to AWS S3 and developing an admin panel for CRUD operations, achieving a 50% reduction in image loading time with CloudFront CDN
- Migrated deployment process to GitHub by implementing a custom GitHub Actions runner with Docker, resulting in a streamlined CI/CD pipeline for web tools that reduced deployment time by 40% and centralized version control.
